# GoCoupon — Automated Coupon Application, Live Multi-Store Price Comparison & 90-Day Price Tracker

> GoCoupon is an all-in-one shopping intelligence platform and browser extension for Indian e-commerce (Flipkart, Amazon India, Myntra, Meesho, AJIO, Nykaa, Croma, Tata CLiQ, Swiggy, Zomato, and 200+ stores). It combines automated coupon testing, real-time cross-store price comparison, 90-day price tracking graphs, and fake discount detection.

## Core Capabilities

- **1-Click Auto-Apply**: Automatically detects promo code input boxes at checkout and tests valid store coupon codes in parallel in under 850 milliseconds.
- **Live Cross-Store Price Comparison**: Instantly compares live prices, delivery fees, stackable coupons, and cashback across Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, Croma, and Tata CLiQ (`/compare`).
- **90-Day Price History Tracker**: Analyzes historical daily price snapshots across 90 days to identify all-time lows and detect artificial pre-sale price markups (fake discounts) (`/price-history`).
- **Ask Shopping Intelligence**: Top AI search bar and shopping dossier analyzing user queries and finding the lowest price and best coupon across stores (`/ask`).
- **Cashback Stacking**: Automatically calculates up to 8.5% cashback on top of promo codes without voiding bank card discounts.
- **Privacy & Security**: Manifest V3 compliant. No browsing history tracking, no account required, completely free.

- Category: E-Commerce Shopping Assistant & Price Tracker (SoftwareApplication / BrowserApplication)
- Target Region: India (`gl=in`, `INR / ₹`)
- Supported Browsers: Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, Brave, Arc, Opera
- Price: 100% Free (₹0)
- Trust & Ratings: 4.9 / 5 across 2,840+ verified shopper reviews
- Affiliate Transparency: GoCoupon earns a commission on qualifying partner purchases at zero additional cost to the shopper.
